content.title: Terms of Use

articles.title: About this website
paragraphs: The website is operated by MAOUAJ Technology, meaning Grupo Maouaj S.A. (Guatemala) and Maouaj Technology Corporation (USA) ("MAOUAJ Technology", "we", "us" or "our"). It provides general information about our company, our technology products and projects, and the business interests connected with us.
The website is for information only. Nothing on it is an offer to sell, a contract, or financial, legal or professional advice.

articles.title: Products in development
paragraphs: Several products described on the website, including the Cashless Bus Fare Platform and the Payment / Money Transfer Platform, are **in development**. Others, such as the Ride-Hailing Platform and the E-commerce Platform, are **planned**.

Descriptions of these products explain what we intend to build. They are not promises that a product will be released, released on a particular date, available in a particular country, or include any particular feature, payment method or price. Product scope, availability and service terms may change, and they will be published separately when a product launches.

articles.title: Ownership of content
paragraphs: All content on the website, including text, graphics, logos, images, designs and the arrangement of that content, belongs to MAOUAJ Technology or is used with permission, and is protected by intellectual property laws.

You may view the website and print or save pages for your own personal, non-commercial reference. You may not copy, reproduce, modify, distribute, publish or use any content for commercial purposes without our prior written permission.
Names and logos of MAOUAJ Technology and connected businesses are trademarks or trade names of their owners. Nothing on the website gives you a right to use them.

articles.title: Acceptable use
paragraphs: When using the website, you agree not to:

- use it in any way that breaks applicable law
- send false, misleading, offensive or unlawful information through our contact form
- send spam, advertising or unsolicited bulk messages
- attempt to gain unauthorized access to the website, its servers or any connected system
- introduce viruses, malware or other harmful code
- disrupt or overload the website, or use automated tools to scrape or copy it at scale
We may restrict access to the website for anyone who breaks these rules.

articles.title: Inquiries you send us
paragraphs: When you contact us, you confirm that the information you send is accurate and that you are entitled to share it. Please do not send confidential information through the contact form. Sending an inquiry does not create a business relationship or any obligation on either side.
How we handle the personal information in your inquiry is explained in our [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy).

articles.title: External links
paragraphs: The website contains links to external websites, including websites of businesses connected with MAOUAJ Technology. These links are provided for convenience. We do not control those websites and are not responsible for their content, availability, products or privacy practices. Visiting them is at your own risk and subject to their own terms.

articles.title: Accuracy and availability
paragraphs: We work to keep the website accurate and up to date, but we do not guarantee that all information is complete, current or free of errors. The website is provided "as is" and "as available". We may change, suspend or remove any part of it at any time without notice.

articles.title: Limitation of liability

Nothing in these Terms excludes or limits liability that cannot be excluded or limited by law.

articles.title: Changes to these Terms

intro: This Privacy Policy explains how MAOUAJ Technology, meaning Grupo Maouaj S.A. (Guatemala) and Maouaj Technology Corporation (USA) ("MAOUAJ Technology", "we", "us" or "our") collects, uses, shares and protects information when you visit our website or contact us through it.
This website is a corporate information website. It does not offer user accounts, online purchases or payments.
content.heading: Privacy Policy

articles.title: Information we collect
paragraphs: **Information you give us.** When you send an inquiry through our contact form, we collect:

- your name
- your email address
- the area you are interested in (for example, a product, a business inquiry or a partnership)
- your phone number and organization, if you choose to give them (optional)
- the message you write
If you email or call us directly, we receive the information you choose to share in that email or call.

**Information collected automatically.** When you visit the website, our hosting and infrastructure providers automatically record standard technical information, such as your IP address, browser type, device type, the pages you visit, the date and time of your visit and the referring website. This information is used to deliver the website, keep it secure and fix problems.

**Cookies.** The website uses only cookies and similar technologies that are necessary for it to work and stay secure. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies. If we introduce analytics or other non-essential cookies in the future, we will update this policy and, where required, ask for your consent first.

articles.title: How we use your information
paragraphs: We use the information described above to:

- respond to your inquiry and continue the conversation you started
- consider business inquiries and partnership proposals
- operate, maintain, secure and improve the website
- detect and prevent spam, abuse and security incidents
- comply with legal obligations and protect our legal rights
We do not sell your personal information, and we do not use it for automated decision-making.

articles.title: Legal bases for processing
paragraphs: Where data protection laws require a legal basis, we rely on:

- **your consent**, when you choose to send us an inquiry
- **our legitimate interests** in responding to inquiries, running and securing our website, and developing our business
- **legal obligations**, where we must keep or disclose information by law

articles.title: Who we share information with
paragraphs: We share personal information only with service providers that help us run the website and handle inquiries, such as website hosting, database, file storage and email providers. They may process information only on our instructions and must protect it.
We may also disclose information if required by law, to protect our rights or the safety of others, or as part of a merger, acquisition or sale of all or part of our business.

articles.title: International transfers
paragraphs: We have offices in more than one country, and our service providers may store or process information in other countries, including the United States. Where we transfer personal information internationally, we take reasonable steps to make sure it remains protected in line with this policy and applicable law.

articles.title: How long we keep information
paragraphs: We keep inquiry information for as long as needed to respond to you and follow up, and in any case no longer than 24 months after our last contact, unless we need to keep it longer for legal reasons or an ongoing business relationship. Technical logs are kept for the limited periods set by our hosting providers.

articles.title: How we protect information
paragraphs: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect personal information, including encrypted connections (HTTPS) and restricted access to inquiry data. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

articles.title: Your rights and choices
paragraphs: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to:

- ask what personal information we hold about you and request a copy
- ask us to correct inaccurate information
- ask us to delete your information
- object to or ask us to restrict certain processing
- withdraw your consent at any time, where we rely on consent
- complain to your local data protection authority
- confirm that we do not sell or share your personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising, as described under US state privacy laws such as those of California and New York
To make a request, contact us using the details below. We may need to verify your identity before acting on it. We will not treat you differently for exercising your rights.

articles.title: Children
paragraphs: This website is not directed at children under 13 (or under 16 in certain jurisdictions, such as the European Economic Area), and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them. If you believe a child has sent us information, please contact us and we will delete it.

articles.title: Links to other websites
paragraphs: Our website links to external websites, including websites of businesses connected with MAOUAJ Technology. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those websites. Please read their privacy policies.

articles.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy from time to time. The updated version will be posted on this page with a new effective date. If the changes are significant, we will make that clear on the website.
